svg.title: What the settings page shows for an answer
svg.desc: The settings page sends a save or Disconnect to Nextcloud and shows one sentence for whatever comes back. When the browser gets no answer, the sentence says that Nextcloud could not be reached. HTTP 401 or 412 means that the session expired, and HTTP 503 with the headers that Nextcloud sends in maintenance mode and before an upgrade that Nextcloud is in maintenance mode. A refusal of the app brings its own message in the language of the administrator. An answer of the app shows the settings as Nextcloud stored them, with the URL in its stored form, and the message of success. An error without a message of the app, such as the HTML page of a proxy or a 503 without those headers, gives the request failed with its HTTP status, and a success that isn't JSON, such as a login page in front of Nextcloud, says that Nextcloud gave an unexpected answer. Every message has the colour and the icon of its kind, and Disconnect is on only while a token or a URL is stored.
